scope: DC candidate comparison, not circuit qualification

assumptions.pack_origin: 3x manufacturer general 3V floor; 3x existing static CUV minimum; 3x4.2V full charge. Dynamic cell floor not qualified.
assumptions.current_origin: comparison points, not measured control load or REG1 output current; BREG base and IC current use a separate feed
assumptions.diode_scope: BAT46W 25C limits at 10mA and 250mA respectively; cross-product is sensitivity analysis, not guaranteed bounds at other currents/temperatures
assumptions.regin_scope: TI 7.11 conditional upper regulation voltage, requires BAT>8V and suitable transistor
assumptions.VCE_origin: engineering screening allowance; not a guaranteed FCX495 dropout specification

selection: 22.1 ohm as next feed candidate; separate branch fault protection required
unknowns: actual local controller and interface load
transistor gain and SOA over temperature
capacitor effective values and loop stability
branch short protection and PCB thermal path
